size.description: Human review burden of this change.

baseSha.description: Commit baseRef resolved to when this document was written. refresh diffs from it.

headSha.description: Commit headRef resolved to when this document was written. refresh diffs from it.

previous.description: File name of the review this one was refreshed from, in the same directory. refresh writes it; the UI compares the two.

title.description: Short name of the whole change. Prefer a user-created title when it names this change.

summary.description: Short what of the whole change. Name the stories.

why.description: Generated why for the whole change, from tickets, issues, a request description, or a transcript. Cite sources with [text](source:id).

sources.description: Locators the skill read to write its prose. Ticket bodies, PR descriptions, and transcript text stay out. PR comment body is copied.

lookFor.description: Source verdicts: a source item done differently, not done, or not true at head, manual steps a source says the change needs, and instructions a source gives a reviewer. Cite the source.

parts.description: One entry per independent story when groups use part. name matches group part. summary is that story's one-sentence what.

name.description: Short name of the independent story. Same string as group part.

summary.description: One sentence: what this independent story is.

why.description: Why this group exists, when a source states a reason the document why and this summary do not.

summary.description: One easy sentence: what this group does and how its hunks relate.

attention.description: The one judgment call a reviewer makes in this group. Most groups have none.

kind.description: contract: a compatibility or API promise. tradeoff: a cost accepted for a gain. product: a product or scope call. risk: a risk accepted.

note.description: What the code at head does, where it matters, and the decision the reviewer makes.

questions.description: At most 2 questions that ask why the change is this way, where the code and the sources leave the reason open. When a source answers one, the answer goes in why.

focus.description: Ranges the UI opens a hunk to. Each sits inside one live hunk of this group and spans at most 25 lines. The whole hunk is one click away.

path.description: Git path of a file this group covers.

side.description: old: a line of the base file. new: a line of the head file.

end.description: Last line, inclusive. At most 25 lines from start.

caption.description: One sentence: what these lines show.

notes.description: Line-anchored notes the UI letters A, B, C.

path.description: Git path of a file this group covers.

side.description: old: a line of the base file. new: a line of the head file.

line.description: 1-based line on that side, inside a hunk this group covers.

body.description: What the code alone does not say about this line.

fileNotes.description: Keyed by the git path of a file this group covers: what changed in that file, past what the summary says. One per file in a group of two or more.

dependsOn.description: Ids of earlier groups this one depends on. Same story only.

part.description: Short name of the independent story this group belongs to. Same name = same story. Different names could have been separate PRs.

sources.description: Ids of document sources this group names, even when the prose does not cite them inline.

items.description: A git path (every live hunk of that file), a directory ending in / (every live hunk under it), or path@oldStart+newStart. A rename is old -> new@oldStart+newStart.

hunkRefs.description: A path string covers every live hunk of that file. path@oldStart+newStart is one hunk. old -> new@oldStart+newStart is a renamed hunk.

title: Comprehende ReviewDocument
description: Interpretation only: title, groups, summaries, and hunk pointers.

label.description: Short name shown in the UI. Examples: #24, alice on PR #32, Cursor session · Aug 12.

gist.description: A short phrase, written by the skill, saying why this source matters. Omit when title says it.

part.description: Short name of the independent story this source belongs to. Same name as the groups in that story.

path.description: pr-comment only. Git path. With side and line, pins the comment to live git.

side.description: pr-comment only. Uses the old and new sides of the diff, not the names a forge gives them.

line.description: pr-comment only. 1-based line on that side.
